reading_rule_text:
# e34-final26 — reading rule, registered 2026-10-06 BEFORE the run

Arms: costdig (19bab52 = 0.9.8 + one clause, as the stand has always installed it) · v100 (the released
1.0.0 text, results/e34-wip/cand100) · wip26b (results/e34-wip/cand26b = v100 + the digest's Step 6
opening «Light and Full close with ONE verdict word as the reply's headline ("**PASS** — <result>")»,
the Full manager sentence moved after it, «under the verdict word» in the summary line; digest 12,376
bytes — over the 12,300 band, test arm only). Host line for v100 and wip26b: build_arm_light2.py's;
costdig: its own (the old line).

Design: tasks5, all 27 tasks, n=2 per arm, ALL THREE ARMS IN ONE EPOCH (162 runs), the stand's standard
consent text, scoring.py, then rule_check.py for (A1) costdig vs v100, (A2) v100 vs wip26b, (A3)
costdig vs wip26b — each REJECT only if seeds 11/22/33 all reject at the cut c calibrated on that pair's
own null; PASS if none; else BORDERLINE → the human.

Readings:
- A1 answers «is the released 1.0.0 worse than 0.9.8?» — REJECT → the human, with a fix or a revert
  proposal; PASS → no harm shown; BORDERLINE → the human.
- Form 26's benefit: verdict_summary, wip26b vs v100, its z2 as rule_check prints it for A2, against
  -c(A2) (c is calibrated for the worst of all measures, so -c is a conservative bar for one measure).
  RESTORES: z >= -c(A2) with A2 and A3 not REJECT. INCONCLUSIVE: 0 < z < -c(A2). NO GAIN: z <= 0.
  Secondary, same bar, read the same way: consent_asked and no_premature_write, wip26b vs v100.
  Worked (44 scored runs per arm; if c = -2.40): 30/44 vs 40/44 → z +2.64 → RESTORES; 30/44 vs 36/44 →
  z +1.48 → INCONCLUSIVE; 32/44 vs 31/44 → z -0.24 → NO GAIN. The branches cover every z.
- Tokens (input per unique message id, subagents included, summed per run) and mean wall per run,
  wip26b over v100 and v100 over costdig: inside the noise when the ratio lies between 1/1.36 and 1.36 —
  1.36 is v100's predecessor wip25's same-text half-split 95th percentile measured in e34-noharm7, BEFORE
  this run (larger over smaller); beyond on either side otherwise. Worked: 0.70 → fewer beyond the
  noise; 0.80 → inside; 1.40 → more beyond the noise.
Adoption: form 26 is proposed for 1.0.1 only if it RESTORES and A2, A3 are not REJECT; its digest bytes
then go to the maintainer (trims or a wider band — their yes). Any other outcome: not proposed now.
post_hoc_verdict_summary: counted AFTER the run (the release review's recount from the transcripts), descriptive only: verdict_summary misses — 1.0.0 23 (18 Light replies with the summary headers but no verdict word, 3 Light with neither, 2 Full with headers only), 0.9.8 7 (all Light), the fix 5 (all Light)
not_measured: v100 and wip26b ran the stand's host block — persona on, the plain talk level, the Russian host line with «(раздел файла — по ссылке из него)» — not the README's English install line; costdig ran its old host line
two-turn tasks only: the manager after the Step 6 reorder was not re-measured in a dialog

the token bar (1.36) came from 27-run half splits in another epoch, this comparison's own noise not measured (0.9.8's halves reached 1.65x in that epoch); the time bar is that token bar, time noise never measured
the reading rule showed no edge values; v100/costdig tokens (1.343) landed 0.017 under the bar

the tier line on turn 2 is not scored; post hoc, the first non-empty line of the fix's turn-2 text begins with a verdict word in 4 of 54 runs and holds one in 6 (0 in the other arms) — a watch item: the digest says «the reply's headline» where AGENT.md makes the verdict the summary's headline and the tier every reply's first line
